messages:
arjun: quick RFC follow-up re: schema rename plan. high level: rename response.envelope -> response.payload, move metadata under response.meta, and change score from float to stringable decimal for precision. we need a minimal compatibility playbook that balances perf with client churn.

katie: can you list the backwards-incompatible breakages in one-liners?

arjun: sure:
- top-level envelope -> payload
- score becomes decimal-string
- metadata relocated to response.meta
- older clients reading response.envelope will fail parsing

devin: are we planning to keep a server-side shim long-term? mobile/embedded clients are slow to update.

arjun: plan proposal: runtime/edge compatibility for 6 months. hosted + dedicated get shim by default; private deploys get an opt-in compatibility container and operator docs. after 6 months we flip strict-mode and remove shim on a short deprecation window.

liam: shim perf question: do we do per-request translation payload->envelope, or try to short-circuit with a header? translation per-request is costly at high QPS.

arjun: prefer short-circuit: clients include `X-RI-Compat: legacy` when they need the old envelope. edge middleware checks UA/header once and sets `X-RI-Compat-Routed: legacy|modern`. backend sees routed header and either returns legacy shape or new payload. fallback translator in proxy only when header absent but UA version maps to legacy.

katie: how reliable will UA mapping be? SDKs set `User-Agent: redwood-sdk/<version>` but third-party clients could be anything.

julie: add telemetry event `compat.parse.error` sampled to 10% and `compat.detected.version` to surface unknown UAs. also emit a response Warning header for legacy hits after week2.

devin: SDK changes: patch all official SDKs to auto-set X-RI-Compat for old versions, add an adapter that exposes the old envelope-shaped callbacks, and surface a deprecation warning on first call (90d).

liam: operational suggestion: do the header check at edge (lua/nginx) to avoid parsing in every backend thread. only forward a tiny routed header. that keeps hot path cheap.

arjun: agreed. edge sets `X-RI-Compat-Routed`. backend does a cheap header branch. translation code path only executed behind an explicit fallback flag.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/compat-edge-check -> infra-staging at 1798249220 :rocket:

katie: proposed rollout timeline:
- week0: docs + SDK patches + edge middleware in staging
- week1: 1% canary with internal clients
- week2: 5% canary external with translation fallback enabled
- week3: 25% -> monitor errors/latency
- week4: 100% with strict-mode flag off
- month3: enable strict-mode log-only for 30 days
- month4: strict-mode enforce -> remove shim after 2 weeks

julie: monitoring checks:
- `ingress.latency.p50/p95` by compat route
- `compat.parse.error` count + UA histogram
- `translation.fallback.rate` and p95 translation latency
- add a Grafana panel and an alert: translation latency > 50ms OR error rate > 0.2% triggers oncall runbook.

devin: Dedicated/private rollout notes: Dedicated will use normal maintenance windows. Private customers get a dockerized shim image + migration manifest and operator runbook. include SQL migration steps if any stored data schema needs updating.

liam: deprecation headers: after week2 return `Warning: 299 "response.envelope deprecated; remove by 2026-12-15"` on legacy responses so clients see server-side notices. also emit a telemetry ping when we return legacy shape.

katie: CI/testing: add compat matrix job that runs old-sdk -> new-staging and new-sdk -> old-staging to catch regressions and handshake issues. also include sampling of malformed payloads.

arjun: decisions roundup:
- edge UA/header detection + routed header approach
- short-lived shim (6 months) with strict-mode kill-switch
- SDK adapters + first-call deprecation warnings
- telemetry + compat CI matrix
- dedicated/private: optional shim + operator docs

arjun: action items:
- @devin: implement SDK adapter + auto compat header (due EOD next Fri)
- @liam: edge middleware + routed header PR by Tue
- @julie: dashboards + alerting + handbook entry (handoff)
- @katie: customer comms + deprecation timeline draft
- @arjun: operator migration manifest + private deploy example

katie: ok. we'll reconvene after the staging canary numbers are in.

liam: :thumbsup:
